lead: Sandhya Mukhopadhyay was an Indian playback singer, born on 4 October 1931 in Dhakuria.
She died on 15 February 2022 in Kolkata at the age of 90.
She has 14 credited works on public record and has been recognised with Banga Bibhushan and National Film Award for Best Female Playback Singer.
The sections that follow break down Sandhya Mukhopadhyay's biography into quick facts, early life, career history, personal life and a year-by-year timeline.
